file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/8942/1_8942_init.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(file_path)

# Read the sheets
df_overview = pd.read_excel(xls, 'Overview')
df_pay_dates = pd.read_excel(xls, 'Pay Dates')

# The instruction says A2 is the data validation list. 
# In the provided data extent for 'Overview', row 0 is the header.

# This means:
# Row 1 (Header): Date, Paycheck 1, Pay check 2
# Row 2 (Index 0): 2016-01-29, 1000.0, 1000.0  <- This is A2, B2, C2
# Row 3 (Index 1): NaN, NaN, NaN
# Row 4 (Index 2): Total Bi Weekly ..., 2000.0, NaN
# Row 5 (Index 3): Total Monthly ..., NaN, NaN <- This is A5, B5, C5

# The value in A2 (df_overview.iloc[0, 0]) is 2016-01-29.
selected_date = df_overview.iloc[0, 0]

# Convert selected_date to datetime to extract month and year
selected_date = pd.to_datetime(selected_date)
month = selected_date.month
year = selected_date.year

# Now calculate the monthly total from 'Pay Dates' sheet
# 'Pay Dates' columns: Date, Paycheck 1, Paycheck 2
df_pay_dates['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_pay_dates['Date'])
mask = (df_pay_dates['Date'].dt.month == month) & (df_pay_dates['Date'].dt.year == year)
monthly_data = df_pay_dates[mask]

# Sum of all paychecks (Paycheck 1 and Paycheck 2) for that month
total_paychecks = monthly_data['Paycheck 1'].sum() + monthly_data['Paycheck 2'].sum()

# Target cell B5 is row index 3, column index 1 in df_overview
df_overview.iloc[3, 1] = total_paychecks

# Save the modified spreadsheet
with pd.ExcelWriter('/mnt/data/outputs/8942_0_df4075d9/1_8942_output.xlsx', engine='openpyxl') as writer:
    df_overview.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Overview', index=False)
    df_pay_dates.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Pay Dates', index=False)

print(f"Calculated total: {total_paychecks}")
